tech.tailwind: Tailwind CSS v4 — design systems at speed

about.title: Engineering mindset, <accent>designer's eye</accent>.
about.lead: I'm Raghad, a Software Engineering student at Al-Azhar University and a frontend developer who cares about every pixel and every millisecond.
about.body1: My journey started with curiosity about how great products feel so natural to use. Today I build production interfaces with React, JavaScript (ES6+), and Tailwind CSS v4 — from design systems and reusable component libraries to full SaaS dashboards wired to REST APIs.
about.body2: Through internships at Taqat (CodeMap), Areisto, and Afaaqware, I've learned to ship in real teams: reading designs closely, writing maintainable code, and collaborating through code reviews. Winning 1st place at the Taqat Hackathon 2026 taught me how to move fast without breaking the experience.

timeline.title: Experience & <accent>education</accent>
timeline.description: The milestones that shaped how I build — from the classroom to production teams.

taqat-hackathon.title: 1st Place Winner
taqat-hackathon.description: Led the frontend of the winning team's product — from rapid prototyping to a polished, demo-ready interface built under tight time pressure.

taqat.title: Frontend Developer Intern
taqat.description: Built responsive, reusable React components and integrated them with REST APIs, working inside an agile team with code reviews and shared design systems.

areisto.title: Frontend Developer Intern
areisto.description: Translated product designs into production-ready interfaces, focusing on component reusability, consistent styling, and cross-browser quality.

afaaqware.title: Frontend Developer Intern
afaaqware.description: Contributed UI features to client projects with React and Tailwind CSS, sharpening fundamentals in modern JavaScript and Git-based collaboration.

freelance.title: Freelance Frontend Developer
freelance.description: Designing and building landing pages, storefronts, and dashboards for clients — owning everything from requirements to deployment.

alazhar.title: B.Sc. Software Engineering
alazhar.description: GPA 87%. Coursework in software architecture, data structures, databases, and human-computer interaction.
